findings.message: PROCESS, not a defect: the recorded adversarial pass on revision-4b7ba535 returned one major, three minors and one nit (all fixed in 00e40d2) — the withheld-attempt hook was wired to the tool that ignores it instead of the host-exec tool that reads it, the nested exemption exempted the whole host space, `samePathMounts` compared raw strings, the Chinese README kept a duplicate row, and the ledger was process-scoped rather than session-scoped.
